newsitem.title: USA: Full House says Deadwood sale cancelled.
newsitem.headline: Full House says Deadwood sale cancelled.

text.p: Full House Resorts Inc on Monday said its planned sale of the Deadwood Gulch Resort and casino, located in Deadwood, South Dakota, to entities controlled by investor Kenneth Kellar has been cancelled.
The parties were unable to come to agreement on terms and could not negotiate an extension beyond a May 1 deadline, Full House said in a statement.
The proposed deal was originally announced on April 18.
"We are disappointed the sale of the resort was not completed, but are optimistic about operations during the upcoming summer season," Chairman Allen Paulson said.
Full House noted that in 1996, Deadwood improved its net operating results by about $200,000 from 1995's results, but added it still plans to sell the resort.

In addition, Full House said Paulson has presented the company with the opportunity to participate in several of his personal investments, including the possible acquisitions of Riviera Holdings Corp ; Elsinore Corp ; a stake in the Gold River Hotel and Casino in Laughlin, Nev.; and a riverboat in Tunica, Miss.
Full House said it has formed a committee that excludes Paulson to consider the investments.
